Claim: G1 is assessed per leg from its sub-goals G2–G4 (combine in safety_case.py): challenged if any sub-goal is challenged; supported if none is challenged and at least one is supported; otherwise no evidence. A leg therefore supports G1 only with respect to the sub-goals it tests (see the per-leg table).

A sub-goal is supported only if its SPI has no event beyond threshold + tolerance and the leg had enough exposure; no evidence = no event but too little exposure (e.g. goal3 never enters the speed zone, goal1 never comes within 1.5 m of keepout).
